msg: I think to get a high score, match the colour of the basket with the next set of gnomes hats. If one the hat colours is a component of the colour of the basket, choose that one. If neither hat colour can be made from the basket colour, choose the primary colour.eg. red basket -> yellow hat gnome and purple hat gnome, choose the purple hat gnome.Yellow basket -> red hat gnome and pink hat gnome, choose the red hat gnome. I think you also get more mushrooms for picking secondary colours, orange (red + yellow), purple (red + blue), and green (yellow + blue), than for red, yellow and blue. There is also a brown hat, but I'm not sure where that fits in.Also make good advantage of the breaks and don't rush them, give yourself time to relax, 5 minutes is longer than you think.
